subject: 21 Truro Avenue Carriage House ADU Proposal
overview: The Commission reviewed a design proposal for a new carriage house and accessory dwelling unit at 21 Truro Avenue and discussed plans for future educational sessions with historic preservation experts.

items.title: 21 Truro Avenue Certificate of Appropriateness
items.summary: The Commission reviewed a proposal for a new two-story carriage house and accessory dwelling unit but deferred a final decision until the applicant provides specific designs for the balcony, egress stairs, and window dimensions.

items.title: Correction of April Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Approved the corrected minutes from April 9 to rectify a typographical error regarding Community Preservation Act funding for 132 High Street.

items.title: Approval of May Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Approved the May meeting minutes with a correction to the spelling of a commission member's name.

items.title: Administrative Update and Educational Planning
items.summary: The Commission discussed organizing public educational sessions during the winter months featuring experts on historic windows, masonry, and millwork.

items.title: Commission Vacancies
items.summary: Staff announced current vacancies on the board and encouraged volunteers to apply through the mayor's office.
